records.title: RelaCtrl: Relevance-Guided Efficient Control for Diffusion Transformers
records.reason: RelaCtrl reduces diffusion-transformer control cost through relevance-guided efficient control. It offers a concrete efficiency method, but only for diffusion generation/control rather than language-model inference.

records.title: OntoTune: Ontology-Driven Self-training for Aligning Large Language Models
records.reason: OntoTune performs ontology-driven self-training to align LLMs. Its mechanism and evaluation concern training/alignment quality, not inference efficiency.

records.title: HG-PIPE: Vision Transformer Acceleration with Hybrid-Grained Pipeline
records.reason: HG-PIPE designs a hybrid-grained pipeline for accelerating vision transformers. It provides hardware acceleration evidence, but the evaluated models are ViT and the paper does not demonstrate applicability to LLM serving.

records.title: Enhancing Post-Training Quantization Calibration Through Contrastive Learning
records.reason: The paper uses contrastive learning to improve post-training quantization calibration and evaluates vision models. It is a concrete quantization method, but evidence is vision-only and does not establish gains for language-model inference.

records.title: SWAT: An Efficient Swin Transformer Accelerator Based on FPGA
records.reason: IEEE publisher full text was not accessible; the conference-hosted material available was presentation slides, not the paper body. Abstract/secondary metadata describe SWAT, an FPGA Swin-Transformer accelerator, but full methods and evaluation could not be verified.
